messages.author: d29c8be76fe2badd
messages.subject: Session handling in Shiny server
parts:
Greetings of the day..

In my shiny app when the browser disconnects and come back within 15 second then the server retains the session state and is able to restore the client UI. I think it correctly follows from the information given at

https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/reconnecting.html

However, when the time of disconnect is greater than 15 seconds then the server closes the session and reconnection happens after client gets back. I am interested to know if

1. Is there  a way to increase this time limit (either in open source or pro version?)
2. Does sessionTimeout variable (availabe in pro version) affect this limit?

regards
-Chinmay

messages.author: 48725385c294169f
messages.subject: Re: Session handling in Shiny server
parts:
Looking at the shiny-server source, I don't think they make it configurable for users: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/blob/0a44b6fc2efb0fbe1b77e5746afa37ebc0b0b8d4/lib/proxy/robust-sockjs.js#L40-L47

If you really want, you could modify the source where this gets called: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/blob/48aa03634e298ebdc780e50e173df9a9869f7221/lib/proxy/sockjs.js#L48

and build a custom shiny-server for yourself.
